verses.en: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
verses.sm: Piu3ina ua sii mai ia Isaraelu Saulo, a o le tausaga e lua na fai ai o ia ma tupu ia Isaraelu,

verses.en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.
verses.sm: ona filifilia lea e Saulo tagata o Isaraelu e tolu afe; sa ia Saulo afe e lua i Mekemase ma le mauga o Peteli; sa ia Ionatana le afe e tasi i Kipea o Peniamina; a o le nuu ua totoe ua ia aauina atu i latou ia taitasi ma alu i lona fale ie.

verses.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.
verses.sm: Ua fasia e Ionatana le leoleoga a Filisitia sa i Kipea; ua faalogo i ai Filisitia. Ona ili ai lea o le pu e Saulo i le nuu uma, ua faapea ane o ia, Ia faalogo ai sa Eperú.

verses.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai Isaraelu uma, ua faapea, Ua fasia e Saulo le leoleoga a Filisitia; ua inosia ai foi Isaraelu e Filisitia. Ona faapotopoto ai lea o le nuu ia Saulo i Kilikala.

verses.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopoto Filisitia e tau ma Isaraelu, e tolu sefulu afe o kariota, e ono afe o e tietie i solofanua, ma tagata pei o le oneone ile matafaga ona toatele; ua latou o ae, ma to lauapi i Mekemase i gagae o Petavene.

verses.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e tagata o Isaraelu ua pagatia i latou, (auā ua atuatuvale le nuu,) ona lalafi ai lea o le nuu i ana, ma le vao talatala, ma gaoa, ma ‘olo maualuga, ma lua.

verses.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
verses.sm: Ua sopoia atu foi Ioritana e Eperu, ua oo i le nuu o Kato ma Kiliata; a e nofo pea Saulo i Kilikala, o loo mulimuli ia te ia le nuu uma ma le tetemu.

verses.en: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
verses.sm: Ua faatali o ia i aso e fitu, o aso ia na atofa atu ai e Samuelu; a e lei alu atu Samuelu i Kilikala, ua taape foi le nuu sa ia te ia.

verses.en: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o Saulo, Au mai ia te au se taulaga mu ma se taulaga faafetai; ona fai ai lea e ia o le taulaga mu.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.
verses.sm: Io Ua oo ina a uma ona faia e ia o le taulaga mu, faauta ia Samuelu, ua alu atu; ona alu ane lea o Saulo e faafetaiai, ma ofo atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Samuelu, Se a lau mea ua fai na? Ua tali atu Saulo, Na ou vaai, ua taape le nuu sa ia te au, ma Oe foi ua e le sau i aso na atofaina mai, ma ua faapotopoto Filisitia i Mekemase,

verses.en: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na Ou faapea ai, Anei e faaifo mai Filisitia ia te au i Kilikala, a ua ou le faatoga atu i le ALII; cna ou faamalosi lea, ma ou faia le taulaga mu.

verses.en: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Samuelu ia Saulo, Ua e valea i le mea ua e fai na, ua e le tausia le poloaiga a le ALII lou Atua na ia poloai atu ai ia te oe; aua na fai a faatumauina nei e le ALII o lou malo ia lsaraelu e faavavau.

verses.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.
verses.sm: A o lenei, e le tumau lou malo; ua sailia e le ALII se tagata mona e tatau ma lona finagalo, ua poloai le ALII ia te ia e fai ma alii o lona nuu, auá ua e le tausia le mea na poloai mai ai le ALII ia te oe.

verses.en: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
verses.sm: Ua tulai Samuelu, ua alu ae nai Kilikala i Kipea o Peniamina; ona faitau lea e Saulo o le nuu, o e na i al ia te la, pe atoa se ono galau o tagata.

verses.en: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
verses.sm: O Saulo foi, ma Ionatana lona atalii, ma le nuu sa ia te i laua, ua latou nonofo i Kipea o Peniamina; a ua to lauapi Filisitia i Mekemase.

verses.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
verses.sm: Ua o ane o 8 faatafuna nai le togalauapi o Filisitia i ‘au e tolu; ua faasaga atu le tasi ‘au i le ala o Ofira i le nuu o Suala;

verses.en: And another company turned the way to Beth-horon: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
verses.sm: ua faasaga atu le tasi ‘au i le ala o Peteorana, ua faasaga atu le tasi ‘au i le ala o le fanua e feagai ma le vanu o Sepoima i tala ane o le vao.

verses.en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:
verses.sm: Ua leai foi se tufuga fai uamea i le nuu uma o Isaraelu, aua na faapea ane Filisitia, neʻi gaosi e Eperu se pelu po o se tao.

verses.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.
verses.sm: Na alu ifo Isaraelu uma ia Filisitia e taitasi ma faamata ai lona oso uamea, ma le uamea o lana suotosina, ma lona to'i, ma, lana selesaito.

verses.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.
verses.sm: A ua ia te i latou le ‘ili mo selesaito, ma uamea suotoso, ma tui mata tolu, ma to'i, e faamata a“ foi tui povi.

verses.en: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na leai ai se pelu po o se tao i lima o le nuu uma sa ia Saulo ma Ionatana i le aso na tau ai le taua; ua na o Saulo ma Ionatana lona atalii sa i ai.

verses.en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu le leoleoga a Filisitia i le aja o Mekemase. Ua fasia le leoleoga a
